title: Seeking Secrets, Part 5
description: Seeking Secrets, Part 5 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Die in alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Die in alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Word on the street is that Haxhaxor underjacking is still localized to the Shadow's Embrace. Thank Gosh for small favors, eh?

Apparently, the veil between our world and the next is thinnest in the Shadow's Embrace, making it easier for the Haxhaxor's to experiment with interfering with the auto-resurrection signal.

I have to be frank with you now. Someone needs to throw a monkeywrench into their operations before we all start dying *permanently*.

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy stares intently at you*

If people begin permanently dying, that will destroy the economy. And, I suppose, Dungeon Runners as well. All we need now is their final strategy documents. Get to the area called alt.location.haxhaxors off Level 7 in the Shadow's Embrace and die, race through underlife, and steal the secret plans from that level's R&D lab.

I wish I had a witty send-off for you, but it's all I can do to keep from wetting my pants.

Turn-in:

You did it! *flips through the documents* This is perfect...all we'll need.... I'll take it from here. I mean K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. will. I mean, I'm sure *someone* will.

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy begins to return to his normal activities, but stops after a moment to look at you*

I'm sure if there were an official representative of the kingdom here, he would pat you on the back, state you did a great job, and give you a medal if he could. *wink!*

Objectives:

  • Secret Scheme: Henry the Dog ×1

Level range: 48–100
